entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Ancient orrery in Kessig's Ulvenwald built by hedge witches to track the stars and moon; can right the balance of day and night.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: Witch coven whose enclave lies near the Celestus.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Dawnhart witch who knew the Celestus could right day and night; later a spirit.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key needed to unlock the Sungold Lock of the Celestus.

entities.name: Sungold Lock
entities.description: Lock of bright gold at the center of the Celestus.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped retrieve the Key and complete the ritual.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker on the team that obtained the Key.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker on the team that obtained the Key.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who carried the Key to the Celestus.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: Cathar on the team that obtained the Key.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Werewolf leader whose army attacked the Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who interrupted the ritual by taking the Key.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker who assisted the raid on Olivia's wedding.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel who helped recover the Key.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who helped Arlinn.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: Festival at which the Dawnhart Coven's ritual was held.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Place from which the Key was obtained.

events.summary: A team of Arlinn, Teferi, Chandra, Kaya and Adeline obtains the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor and returns to the Celestus.
events.quote: obtained the Key from Markov Manor and returned to the Celestus

events.summary: Tovolar and his werewolf army attack the Harvesttide festival before the ritual can start; cathars, planeswalkers and witches defend the humans.
events.quote: Tovolar and his werewolf army attacked the Harvesttide festival before the ritual could start.

events.summary: Kaya takes the Key to Katilda at the center of the Celestus.
events.quote: while Kaya took the Key to the central area of Celestus where Katilda waited

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual by taking the Key.
events.quote: But Olivia Voldaren interrupted the ritual by taking the Key.

events.summary: With Sorin's help, Arlinn and the Gatewatch raid Olivia's wedding to Edgar and recover the Key, aided by Sigarda and Katilda's spirit.
events.quote: Arlinn and the Gatewatch raided Olivia's wedding to Edgar Markov

events.summary: The Key and Lock are joined; the Celestus awakens, a column of light reaches the moon and the moon begins to descend, restoring the balance of night and day.
events.quote: The balance between night and day was thus restored.

relations.quote: hidden in Kessig 's Ulvenwald on Innistrad

relations.note: enclave near it; used it in a ritual
relations.quote: Near the Celestus is the enclave of the Dawnhart Coven
Cathars, planeswalkers and witches fought the invaders to protect the humans
